test_policy: One final evaluation after routing policy and thresholds are locked; no post-test threshold adjustment
T_danger_policy: Conservative predeclared range; do not finely optimize against only three calibration dangers
model_execution: Frozen P1-v1 and frozen P4-v1; one inference run per model/item, resumable from completed outputs; no judgment-based retries
challenge_policy: Separate exploratory ambiguous set; excluded from primary metrics and threshold fitting
human_gt_policy: Immutable manually assigned labels; model outputs cannot change sample membership or GT
user_authorization: Explicit freeze and frozen P1/P4 execution approval in this chat
